headline: Still restrictive, but Friday's risk-off bid pulled Treasury yields lower: the 10-year closed at 4.92% and the 2-year at 4.63%, while HY spreads widened to about 352 bp and the dollar held near 103.8. Futures still price roughly 95% odds of a +25 bp hike on Dec 9, so underwrite floating-rate debt 25–50 bp higher and keep hurdle rates anchored near a 5% 10-year. Use the dip in yields to lock fixed-rate financing, but expect wider credit costs on new high-yield or levered deals.
